sources.entry: Origami Studio - Tool for designing modern interfaces, built and used by designers at Facebook.

summary.name: Origami Studio
summary.one_liner: Origami Studio 3 is a prototyping tool for designers that builds interactive interface prototypes using a canvas layout and a visual patch editor.
use_cases: Importing designs from Figma or Sketch
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Origami Studio 3 as a tool for designing interfaces with a new canvas interface and dynamic layout that update automatically as changes are made. Components are laid out on the Canvas and combined with interactions in the Patch Editor. Prototypes can use device inputs such as the camera roll, live or recorded audio, the haptic engine, location, and accelerometer and gyroscope data. Editable vector shapes and text layers can be copied and pasted in, and there is a Figma plugin. Prototypes can be captured, trimmed and exported as video, and shared for review.
notable: Visual Patch Editor for building interactions without code
Access to device sensors, haptics, camera roll and location
Built and used by designers at Facebook (per awesome-mac listing)
caveats: Platform support beyond macOS and iOS is not stated on the page
Pricing is not stated on the page
